PROPOSED INPUT CONTRACT

Agree on meaning before connecting.

InputMinimum contextFailure to expose
InventorySKU, site, lot, on-hand, held, usable, as-of timeStale count or unavailable physical reconciliation
PO / receiptLine identifier, quantity, unit, source and timestampUnmatched line or BX/EA mismatch
ConsumptionItem, period, unit and sourceUnexplained gap or incomplete history
Procedure assumptionsSynthetic slots, planned period, assumed item quantityUnverified item-to-procedure relationship

DISCOVERY GATES

Four checks before a replay.

01

Permission

Identify the data owner, export rights, scope and approved access route.

02

Normalization

Verify SKU and unit mappings; explicitly block unreliable conversions.

03

Operational fit

Agree freshness, availability, retention and human review expectations.

SECURITY QUESTIONS

Define the controls with the sponsor.

01

Access

Authentication, role permissions, least privilege and removal of access.

02

Handling

Authorized storage, encryption requirements, retention and deletion.

03

Availability

Recovery expectations, incident ownership and downtime procedures.

QUESTIONS, IN CONTEXT

Before the next handoff.

Which ERP products are connected?+

None in this preview. System-specific mappings and access routes require discovery.

Can we upload sample data here?+

No. This website accepts no file uploads. Any future retrospective data transfer needs a separately approved route.

Is healthcare compliance established?+

No. No certification, compliance or security assurance is claimed by this synthetic demonstration.
